about.label: About Us
about.content: Global Core Technologies combines functional consulting, technical architecture, and risk governance so that every SAP evolution arrives with control, adoption, and continuity. We work with mid-size and large enterprises operating in demanding sectors where SAP is the backbone of their operations.

mission.label: Mission

vision.label: Vision

team.label: Team

s4hana.title: SAP S/4HANA
s4hana.subtitle: ERP for Large Enterprises
s4hana.description: SAP's intelligent ERP for large organizations: integrated end-to-end processes, real-time on HANA, and digital transformation at scale.
s4hana.longDescription: SAP S/4HANA is the next-generation ERP designed for large enterprises that need to operate with full visibility, speed, and adaptability. Built on the SAP HANA in-memory database, it eliminates aggregation layers and enables real-time decisions across the entire value chain: finance, supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, and sales. Global Core Technologies supports S/4HANA projects with proven methodology in high-criticality environments, from target architecture design through post-go-live stabilization, with a focus on operational continuity and real adoption.

cloud-erp.title: SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud
cloud-erp.subtitle: GROW with SAP
cloud-erp.description: Modernize your business management with GROW with SAP: a cloud ERP with industry best practices, automatic updates, and continuous innovation.
cloud-erp.longDescription: SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud with GROW with SAP is the ideal solution for mid-size companies looking to grow with a modern ERP without the complexity of on-premise implementations. You adopt industry best practices from day one, with a predictable subscription model and automatic updates that keep your platform always current. Global Core Technologies supports every stage of adoption — from process design through post-go-live stabilization — ensuring your team operates with confidence and your data is reliable from day one.

cloud-erp-private.title: SAP Cloud ERP Private
cloud-erp-private.subtitle: RISE with SAP
cloud-erp-private.description: Transform your SAP processes with RISE with SAP: a comprehensive package designed for your organization's unique transformation with advanced customization and full control.
cloud-erp-private.longDescription: SAP Cloud ERP Private with RISE with SAP is SAP's most complete digital transformation package, designed for organizations that need to migrate to S/4HANA Cloud while maintaining their level of customization and compliance. It includes private cloud infrastructure, process analysis tools (Business Process Intelligence), SAP BTP integration, and assisted migration support. At Global Core Technologies we accompany from the initial assessment through hyper-stabilization, with proven experience in high-criticality SAP environments where operational continuity admits no interruptions.

btp.title: SAP Business Technology Platform
btp.subtitle: Platform & Innovation
btp.description: SAP's technology platform for developing applications, automating processes, integrating systems, and applying artificial intelligence across the SAP ecosystem.
btp.longDescription: SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is the innovation hub that extends and connects the SAP ecosystem. It enables development of low-code and pro-code applications, workflow automation, integration of heterogeneous systems, and application of AI and machine learning capabilities on SAP data in real time. At Global Core Technologies we use BTP to build Clean Core extensions that add value without compromising standard updates, and we integrate BTP into digital transformation strategies where the platform serves as the technological fabric connecting ERP, data, and business processes.

integration-suite.title: SAP Integration Suite
integration-suite.subtitle: SAP & Non-SAP Integration
integration-suite.description: Connect your SAP landscape with any external system through APIs, iFlows, events, and automations — no friction between SAP and the rest of the business.
integration-suite.longDescription: SAP Integration Suite is SAP's enterprise integration platform that connects cloud and on-premise applications, SAP and non-SAP systems, with a unified approach of APIs, messaging, events, and automation. It includes Cloud Integration for iFlows, API Management for complete API lifecycle, Event Mesh for event-driven architectures, and Integration Advisor for standardized mappings. Global Core Technologies designs and implements integration architectures that reduce technical debt, standardize data flows, and enable digital ecosystems where SAP operates as the nucleus of a connected network of systems.

It enables executive dashboards, collaborative budgets and forecasts, and what-if simulations on real operational data — without replicating information. Global Core Technologies designs and implements analytics and planning models aligned with business processes, so decisions are made on a single version of the truth.
